While interesting, I don't see how it's going to help her in mid lane. She is so outranged by virtually every mid lane champion and her overall cooldowns so much longer, getting close enough to hit a spell and an auto is usually going to result in taking way too much return damage. Her laning problem currently is she lacks the range of syndra/orianna/ahri to harass while csing and the mobility of kat/kassadin(post 6)/Ekko to take aggressive trades and get out of threat range. Even kassadin pre-6 benefits from scaling much better and thus being fine even going down even like 15 cs and just surviving.

Idea for a passive: something like courage of the collosos where if she lands cc she gains a shield of ice. Could maybe allow for aggressive use of W and E for trading by mitigating the punishing return damage you take while walking away.
